payload.summary: Three deployables from one repo: Hono API (src/server), BullMQ worker (src/worker) and a Vite/React web app (src/web)
details: API and worker deploy to Railway from one Dockerfile; infra is code in .railway/railway.ts, applied with `railway config plan/apply`
Railway GitHub triggers use checkSuites, so deploys wait for CI on main
Web deploys to Cloudflare Pages through its Git integration; its build image uses asdf, so .tool-versions must name Node as `nodejs`, not `node`
GET /health is real readiness: it probes Postgres and Redis and returns 503 if either fails; Railway uses it as the healthcheck
The server listens on `::` and ioredis uses family 0 because Railway private networking is IPv6
